decks.notes: This deck aims to disrupt opponents with hatebears while applying aggressive pressure. By utilizing cards like Archon of Emeria and Chancellor of the Annex to slow down the opponent's spells, while also playing efficient creatures like Seasoned Dungeoneer and White Plume Adventurer to apply pressure, the deck can control the game tempo. The inclusion of disruptive lands like Wasteland and Strip Mine further adds to the deck's disruptive nature. Overall, the deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while deploying threats to close out the game quickly.

This deck is focused on controlling the game through various counter spells and removal cards, as well as utilizing the Gifts Ungiven card to search for key cards in the deck. The goal is to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent by consistently disrupting their plays while setting up powerful combos with cards like Underworld Breach and Lórien Revealed. The inclusion of the Companion card, Lurrus of the Dream-Den, provides additional value and flexibility to the deck's strategy. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's powerful spells and ensure consistency in casting them.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with dredge creatures and use cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to enable graveyard shenanigans. By consistently dredging through your deck, you can quickly put out threats like Ichorid, Grief, Hollow One, and Golgari Grave-Troll while also utilizing cards like Creeping Chill and Prized Amalgam for additional value. Force of Will helps protect your combo pieces while cards like Noxious Revival and Narcomoeba provide additional synergy. Chalice of the Void can help disrupt your opponent's strategy while you overwhelm them with your graveyard-based game plan.

This deck aims to quickly combine Phyrexian Dreadnought with a sacrifice effect to create a powerful threat. It also includes various control elements such as counterspells and removal to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional recursion of key cards. Additionally, the deck includes card draw and filtering to help find the combo pieces quickly and maintain card advantage. The overall strategy is to assemble the combo while controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's plans.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while efficiently controlling the board and drawing cards. With a mix of powerful counterspells like Force of Will and cheap removal spells like Fatal Push, along with disruptive cards like Wasteland and Null Rod, this deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out a victory. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds extra consistency and value to the deck, making it a formidable force in the Vintage format.

The deck focuses on efficiently controlling the opponent's actions through a combination of powerful counter spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Orcish Bowmasters. It also utilizes card advantage with draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time, while disrupting the opponent's strategies with cards like Null Rod and Strip Mine. The deck aims to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent in the long run, ultimately grinding them down to secure victory.

This Dimir Control deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption to maintain control of the game. The deck also utilizes powerful draw spells and card selection tools to find answers when needed. With a focus on resource denial and efficient threats, the deck looks to outvalue the opponent and grind out a win through incremental advantage. Additionally, the inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional recursion and value to the deck's game plan.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the Doomsday combo using cards like Dark Ritual, Demonic Tutor, and Doomsday itself to set up a winning sequence of cards. It includes protection in the form of Force of Will, Force of Negation, and other counterspells, as well as card advantage with Ancestral Recall and draw spells like Brainstorm and Gush. Thassa's Oracle serves as the win condition once the combo is assembled, allowing the player to win the game on the spot. The deck is focused on efficiently executing its game plan and disrupting the opponent's strategy.

The deck focuses on deploying hatebear creatures like Anointed Peacekeeper and Archon of Emeria to disrupt the opponent's strategy while still keeping up pressure with aggressive creatures like Clarion Conqueror and Seasoned Dungeoneer. The inclusion of cards like Void Mirror and Chancellor of the Annex adds an additional layer of disruption, making it difficult for the opponent to cast spells efficiently. The mana base is supported by fast mana artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxes, along with powerful land options like Cavern of Souls and Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This Aggro - MUD deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Wasteland, Strip Mine, and Sphere of Resistance while quickly building up its own resources with Mishra's Workshop and artifact mana sources. It also utilizes powerful artifacts such as Black Lotus and Sol Ring to accelerate its game plan, as well as threats like Glaring Fleshraker and Stonecoil Serpent to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to efficiently deploy threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a quick victory.

The focus of this deck is to efficiently gather the necessary cards to assemble the Doomsday combo and win the game quickly. It utilizes a combination of card draw, tutoring, and counterspells to set up the perfect sequence of cards needed to achieve victory. The inclusion of Thassa's Oracle as a win condition in conjunction with Doomsday showcases the deck's ability to win in a variety of ways while also maintaining a strong defense against opposing strategies. With the right setup and sequencing, this deck can be a formidable force in Vintage 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this Dredge combo deck is to utilize cards like Bazaar of Baghdad, Golgari Thug, and Stinkweed Imp to quickly fill up the graveyard with key creatures like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam. By recurring creatures from the graveyard and utilizing cards like Creeping Chill and Hollow One to deal damage, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence and graveyard recursion. It also includes disruption elements like Force of Will and Cabal Therapy to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements such as counterspells, removal, and card advantage to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gaining incremental advantages. It includes a mix of powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Force of Will, and Black Lotus to control the board and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value over the course of the game. Overall, the deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent through efficient spells and strategic decision-making.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through various means such as counter spells, disruptive creatures, and powerful artifacts. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage and mana advantage with cards like Hullbreacher, Mana Drain, and Tolarian Academy. The deck also utilizes powerful win conditions like Karn, the Great Creator, Time Vault combo, and Bolas's Citadel. By effectively controlling the game and outvaluing the opponent, this Dimir Control deck aims to secure victory in the Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on using the combo potential of Paradoxical Outcome, along with various mana acceleration tools like Black Lotus and Moxen, to generate a large amount of mana and draw cards. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional recursion of key cards. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and counterspells to protect the combo pieces. Overall, the key strategy is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent before they can respond effectively.

The deck focuses on aggressively deploying hatebears to disrupt the opponent's game plan while still maintaining a strong board presence. By utilizing cards like Chalice of the Void, Archon of Emeria, and Chancellor of the Annex, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's spells and mana development. It also includes efficient creatures like Clarion Conqueror and Seasoned Dungeoneer to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The deck's mana base is designed to support its aggressive strategy, allowing for fast and consistent deployment of its hatebears.
